 Social Security payment dates 2026: What to expect for rest of year
 Riley Hoffman Wednesday 28 October 2026 12:47 GMT 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover Social Security recipients who don’t receive their payment are advised to wait three days before contacting the administration ( Getty ) The final round of regular October Social Security payments are going out on Oct. 28 for recipients born between the 21st and 31st. 
 Social Security beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th of their birth month received their October payment on Wednesday, Oct. 21, 2026. 
 Standard Social Security checks are distributed on the second, third, or fourth Wednesday of every month depending on the beneficiary's birthday. 
 Exceptions to the standard schedule include recipients who began receiving benefits before May 1997 or those who receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). 
 Remaining SSI payments for 2026 are scheduled to be issued on Oct. 30, Dec. 1, and Dec. 31. See the full calendar here .
